candidates.description: This vector represents Thai words, morphemes, and subwords related to quantities, modifiers, and regional prefixes.
This feature vector activates on Thai syllable endings containing the consonant 'บ' (or 'ด') along with common Thai nominalization prefixes and frequent token fragments.
This feature vector activates on Thai vowel and tone mark diacritics attached to consonant roots.
This vector detects abstract noun prefixes and conceptual root words in Thai text processing.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant character 'ส' (so sua) appearing in various contextual syllables and words.
This feature vector activates strongly on Thai script characters and specific English terms related to Canterbury and England.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens from non-English alphabets, particularly Thai script and accented Latin characters, alongside rare proper nouns and alphanumeric fragments.
This feature vector represents grammatical conjunctions and common connective punctuation used to link words, phrases, or clauses in text.
This vector activates strongly on prominent international organization names and specific linguistic scripts, particularly Thai and Cyrillic/Asian characters.
This vector is related to proper nouns, names, and titles that commonly precede or follow specific places, events, or organizations.
